title: Food-first picks
intro: Pass B deliberately looked past the default tourist-market list. Objective hours stay on Taipei City sources; the local-feeling judgment comes only from independent firsthand accounts.

items.name: Nanjichang Night Market
items.hours: 18:00–00:00 per Taipei City's current food-tracer listing
items.how: Bus or a longer walk from Ximen / CKS Memorial Hall; less MRT-convenient than the marquee markets.
items.price: Street-food budget; choose stall by stall
items.crowd_tip: Two independent recent firsthand source families describe it as more local-feeling and less tourist-heavy than the marquee markets.
items.why: Best fit for the intake's explicit 'where locals actually eat' night-market test.

items.name: logy
items.address: 1F, No. 39, Ln. 258, Ruiguang Rd., Neihu Dist., Taipei
items.hours: Wed–Sun dinner 18:30–22:30 (last order 19:00); Fri–Sun lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 12:30)
items.why: The one planned splurge: a tasting-menu restaurant whose current price, 30-day booking window and cancellation terms are published directly.
